name: The parts working as one whole
vision_statement: The parts of the AI system work together as one whole.
opportunities: An assembled system that checks itself, and parts that each state what they are for, are things a whole needs and rarely gets from its parts alone. Whoever builds on the hub gets them without writing the glue.
solution_coherence: The Self keeps the parts of the system working as one whole. To respond to a request, The Self asks Consciousness for the person's authority and priorities. The Self asks Body where the system's data lives. The Self passes the request on to Intelligence. The Self asks Role Understanding what that part is for, so that no part does another's work. Integrity then audits what the system says about itself and what it did against the run record, and checks that the hub stays generic, with claims that match evidence and records that match code. The Assembler builds the whole from configuration in one call and reports which seats are built and what the rest need. When asked for its health, The Self asks World how current the research is.
